title: FizzBuzz for One Number
statement:
Play one turn of FizzBuzz.

The input is one positive integer `n` on a single line. Print `FizzBuzz` when `n` is divisible by both 3 and 5, `Fizz` when it is divisible by 3 only, `Buzz` when it is divisible by 5 only, and the number itself otherwise.

Input:

```text
15
```

Expected output:

```text
FizzBuzz
```
hints: A number is divisible by 3 when `n % 3` is 0.
Order matters. A number like 15 is divisible by 3 too, so check the both case before the single ones.
